bio-mic-01-c1.text: Ron Sender, Shai Fuchs, Ron Milo (2016). Revised Estimates for the Number of Human and Bacteria Cells in the Body. PLoS Biology.
bio-mic-01-c1.quote: We estimate the total number of bacteria in the 70 kg "reference man" to be 3.8·1013.
bio-mic-01-c1.claim: Of the ~4 × 10¹³ bacterial cells associated with a human body
